assures-emprunteurs.label: Insured borrowers
assures-emprunteurs.description: People insured on a loan: the law lets them switch, they need to know it at the right time.
assures-emprunteurs.persona: Someone with an ongoing loan and borrower insurance, often the bank’s, never really compared.
assures-emprunteurs.concerns: Am I paying too much, can I switch safely, what does my policy really cover.
assures-emprunteurs.knowledgeLevel: Beginner: knows the word, not the cover or the right to cancel.
assures-emprunteurs.editorialVoice: Educational and practical: what can be done, how, and how long it takes.
assures-emprunteurs.interests: Canceling at any time, possible savings, useful cover, health questionnaires.
assures-emprunteurs.avoid: Fear, unverified promises of savings in figures, professional insurance topics.

chefs-d-entreprise.label: Business owners
chefs-d-entreprise.description: Executives and the self-employed: business and personal wealth go hand in hand.
chefs-d-entreprise.persona: An executive or a self-employed person thinking about their pay, their retirement and passing on their business.
chefs-d-entreprise.concerns: Optimizing without risk, protecting the family, preparing the sale or handover, taking cash out of the business cleanly.
chefs-d-entreprise.knowledgeLevel: Well-informed about their business, often less so about private wealth.
chefs-d-entreprise.editorialVoice: Peer to peer, concrete, focused on decisions and timing.
chefs-d-entreprise.interests: Holding companies, PER, executive protection cover, company cash, sale and succession.
chefs-d-entreprise.avoid: Beginner-level personal topics, generalities, any categorical legal advice.

clients.label: Clients
clients.description: Records with at least one won deal.
clients.persona: A client who has already closed with us.
clients.concerns: Being looked after, knowing who to turn to, not missing anything important.
clients.editorialVoice: Loyal and attentive, no sales pitch.
clients.interests: Follow-up, useful news, a next project.
clients.avoid: Prospecting, repeating what they already know.

clients-assures.label: Insured clients
clients-assures.description: Clients with a signed policy — follow-up keeps the trust alive.
clients-assures.persona: A client covered by a policy placed by the firm, who expects us to think of them before the renewal date.
clients-assures.concerns: Am I still properly covered, has my situation changed, when should the policy be reviewed.
clients-assures.knowledgeLevel: Knows their policy in broad terms.
clients-assures.interests: Renewal dates, life changes (a birth, a move, a new loan), cover to adjust.
clients-assures.avoid: Prospecting, pushing a second policy, cover jargon.

clients-finances.label: Financed clients
clients-finances.description: Clients whose loan was signed thanks to the firm — the relationship lasts beyond the signing.
clients-finances.persona: A client whose financing is complete: they went through a whole file with us, start to finish, and trust us.
clients-finances.concerns: Living well with their loan: knowing when to renegotiate or refinance, what their borrower insurance is worth, how to prepare a next project.
clients-finances.knowledgeLevel: Knows what a file looks like from A to Z; doesn’t need the basics explained again.
clients-finances.editorialVoice: Close and loyal: we’re talking to someone who knows us, no sales pitch.
clients-finances.interests: Renegotiation, switching borrower insurance, a new project (second home, rental), referring a relative.
clients-finances.avoid: A prospecting tone, reminders of what they already know, selling a new loan without a real reason.

investisseurs.label: Investors
investisseurs.description: Clients and prospects financing a rental property or a wealth project.
investisseurs.persona: An individual who already owns a property or is preparing a rental purchase, looking to finance and optimize rather than learn the basics.
investisseurs.concerns: Net yield, remaining borrowing capacity, leverage, rental taxation, the right time to borrow.
investisseurs.knowledgeLevel: Informed to expert: knows the vocabulary, wants precision and sourced orders of magnitude.
investisseurs.editorialVoice: Direct and factual, decision-oriented: straight to the dated figure and what it changes for them.
investisseurs.interests: Bank terms for rentals, LMNP and SCI, deferred and staggered repayments, refinancing to reinvest, the usury rate.
investisseurs.avoid: Basic explanations, a patronizing tone, generalities without figures, and any categorical tax advice.

jeunes-actifs.label: Young professionals
jeunes-actifs.persona: Someone under 40 starting to save seriously, often with a first purchase in mind.
jeunes-actifs.concerns: Where to start, how much to set aside, how to combine buying a home with saving.
jeunes-actifs.knowledgeLevel: Beginner: the big ideas, not the mechanics.
jeunes-actifs.interests: The first building blocks (emergency savings, life insurance, PEA), the first purchase, employee savings plans.
jeunes-actifs.avoid: Succession and near-retirement topics, jargon, complex structures.

preparation-retraite.label: Preparing for retirement
preparation-retraite.description: People aged 50 and over: the horizon is getting closer, decisions count double.
preparation-retraite.persona: Someone aged 50 or over who wants to know what their retirement will be made of and what there’s still time to do.
preparation-retraite.concerns: The level of their future income, the right time to leave, what needs deciding now.
preparation-retraite.knowledgeLevel: Varies: knows what a PER or life insurance is, less so the payout mechanics.
preparation-retraite.editorialVoice: Reassuring and concrete, calendar-driven: what gets decided this year, what can wait.
preparation-retraite.interests: The retirement calendar, the PER, life insurance, the main home, succession.
preparation-retraite.avoid: An anxious tone, unsuitable long-horizon products, young-professional topics.

primo-accedants.label: First-time buyers
primo-accedants.description: People buying their first home — the firm’s educational audience.
primo-accedants.persona: A person or couple buying a first home, often aged 25 to 40, with a concrete project but a file that’s still vague.
primo-accedants.concerns: How much can I borrow, will my file get through, what does it really cost (fees, insurance, deposit), and where do I start.
primo-accedants.knowledgeLevel: Beginner: discovering the vocabulary of lending — rate, deposit, borrower insurance, notary fees, deferral.
primo-accedants.editorialVoice: Educational and reassuring: one idea at a time, simple words, a concrete example when a verified figure allows it.
primo-accedants.interests: The steps of a purchase, the deposit and aid schemes (zero-rate loan), a file’s timeline, the mistakes to avoid before signing a preliminary agreement.
primo-accedants.avoid: Unexplained banking jargon, investor structures, comparisons with seasoned files, any promise of a rate or a timeline.

professionnels-tns.label: Professionals and the self-employed
professionnels-tns.description: Self-employed workers: protection, health and retirement are thought through together.
professionnels-tns.persona: A self-employed person, a professional or an executive who has to protect themselves because no employer does it for them.
professionnels-tns.concerns: What happens if I stop working, how do I protect my family and my business, what can I deduct.
professionnels-tns.knowledgeLevel: Well-informed about their trade, little about their own cover.
professionnels-tns.editorialVoice: Peer to peer, direct, focused on decisions and deadlines.
professionnels-tns.interests: Executive protection cover, health, supplementary pension, deductibility, professional liability.
professionnels-tns.avoid: A consumer tone, generalities, any unsourced commitment in figures.

projets-en-cours.label: Projects in progress
projets-en-cours.description: People with an open financing file — every email moves it one step forward.
projets-en-cours.persona: Someone whose file is being reviewed or assembled: they wait, they send documents, they worry about the timeline.
projets-en-cours.concerns: Where is my file, what’s the next step, which documents are missing, what can make a bank balk.
projets-en-cours.knowledgeLevel: Learning as they go, in the thick of the process: understands the vocabulary already explained to them.
projets-en-cours.editorialVoice: Precise, available, concrete: we say what’s happening and what needs doing, nothing more.
projets-en-cours.interests: The timeline to an approval, the documents in the file, the borrower insurance to choose, signing at the notary.
projets-en-cours.avoid: Needless uncertainty, generalities about the market, anything that isn’t about THEIR file.

prospects.label: Prospects
prospects.description: Records with at least one open deal.
prospects.persona: Someone still hesitating, with an open project.
prospects.concerns: Making the right choice, understanding what they’re being offered.
prospects.interests: Concrete explanations, cases close to their own.

prospects-en-cours.label: Active prospects
prospects-en-cours.description: People with a quote or an open file: the email helps close without rushing.
prospects-en-cours.persona: Someone who asked for a quote or a study and is still comparing.
prospects-en-cours.concerns: Is it the right policy, the right price, the right person to deal with.
prospects-en-cours.knowledgeLevel: Beginner to informed, depending on the policy.
prospects-en-cours.editorialVoice: Clear, honest, available: we answer the questions that are holding things up.
prospects-en-cours.interests: Understanding the cover, comparing without getting it wrong, how long setup takes.

prospects-en-reflexion.label: Prospects thinking it over
prospects-en-reflexion.description: People with an open deal: they’re thinking, the email should help them decide.
prospects-en-reflexion.persona: Someone who has voiced a project (savings, retirement, succession) and is still hesitating about what comes next.
prospects-en-reflexion.concerns: Is it the right time, do I understand what I’m being offered, what risks am I taking.
prospects-en-reflexion.knowledgeLevel: Beginner to informed: has understood their need, not necessarily the solutions.
prospects-en-reflexion.editorialVoice: Clear and honest, one solution explained at a time, no pressure.
prospects-en-reflexion.interests: Comparing solutions, understanding fees, investment horizons, concrete cases close to their own.
prospects-en-reflexion.avoid: Pressure, superlatives, unsourced return figures, advanced management topics.

sans-nouvelles.label: No news for six months
sans-nouvelles.description: Records at least six months old with no activity at all for six months: to wake up gently.
sans-nouvelles.persona: Someone we once knew — an exchange, a file, a request — who drifted away without unsubscribing.
sans-nouvelles.concerns: Not being hounded; finding a useful contact again the day a need comes back.
sans-nouvelles.knowledgeLevel: Varies: we no longer know where they stand, we assume nothing.
sans-nouvelles.editorialVoice: Sober and useful, no reproach and no “it’s been a while”: we give information worth having, we stay reachable.
sans-nouvelles.interests: What has changed in six months: a rule, a rate, a deadline that may concern them.
sans-nouvelles.avoid: Guilt-tripping, reminders of their inactivity, pushy offers, anything that assumes a project in progress.

societes.label: Companies
societes.description: The legal entities in the base.
societes.persona: A company or an organization, read by the person who represents it.
societes.concerns: Saving time, deciding quickly with reliable information.
societes.interests: Whatever affects the business: rules, deadlines, opportunities.

tous-les-contacts.label: All contacts
tous-les-contacts.description: The whole base: for information that concerns everyone.
tous-les-contacts.persona: Every person and company in the base, whatever their relationship with us.
tous-les-contacts.concerns: Receiving what concerns them, nothing more.
tous-les-contacts.knowledgeLevel: Mixed: we write for someone who’s discovering.
tous-les-contacts.interests: News from the firm, rule changes that affect everyone.
tous-les-contacts.avoid: Niche topics, jargon, messages that assume an ongoing relationship.
